description: This file defines a TestService class that manages CRUD operations for test scripts within a database context, including creating, retrieving, listing, updating, deleting (soft delete), and counting test scripts. It leverages SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas for data handling, and includes logging for operations.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to create, retrieve, update, delete, and count test scripts using a database session.

methods.name: TestScript create_test_script(self, db: Session, script_data: TestScriptCreate, user_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new test script record in the database with provided data and user context.

methods.name: Optional[TestScript] get_test_script(self, db: Session, script_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a test script by its ID if it is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: List[TestScript] list_test_scripts(self, db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Returns a list of test scripts with pagination, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: TestScript update_test_script(self, db: Session, script_id: str, script_data: TestScriptUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing test script's attributes based on the provided update data.

methods.name: delete_test_script(self, db: Session, script_id: str)
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on a test script by marking it as deleted.

methods.name: int get_total_count(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Returns the total count of active (not deleted) test scripts.
